title: Personal Training Packages: when a refund of unused sessions may be recorded
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states when a refund of a package's unused sessions may be recorded.

## Rule
A refund of unused sessions may be recorded only while the package's own status is active, paused, or in the same moment as its confirmed cancellation to closed. A refund may be recorded only when the member requests it before the tier's own refund window has elapsed since the package was purchased, counted as full calendar days from the purchase date with no partial-day rounding; the moment of the request must not fall later than the purchase date plus the tier's own refund window.

~~The refund amount is the tier's own base refund percentage of the unused-session value, prorated on the tier's own proration basis.~~ This clause is no longer in force for how the refund amount itself is computed; the current basis is stated in the recording-a-package-refund and corporate-wellness-uplift-to-the-refund-percentage documents for this product.

## Points of judgement
- Status gate: a refund may be recorded while the package's status reads active or paused, and it may also be recorded in the same moment the package's own confirmed cancellation transitions its status to closed. A refund may not be recorded while the package's status reads applied, exhausted, or expired, nor at any moment after that closing moment has already passed.
- Timing gate: the request clock starts running from the package's own purchase date. If the request is made on the purchase date itself, or on any of the full calendar days up to and including the day the refund window elapses, the request is within the window; a boundary request made on exactly the last day of the window still qualifies, since the comparison is not-later-than rather than strictly-before. A request made on the calendar day after the window elapses is outside the window and no refund is recorded.
Both gates must hold together: a request made within the window against a package whose status has already lapsed to expired does not qualify, and a request against a package still active but made after the window has elapsed does not qualify either.

superseded_clauses: The refund amount is cancellation_refund_pct of the unused-session value, prorated on refund_proration_basis.
